# uptrace_org (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name   = "My Organization"
  budget = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organization name.

### Optional

- `budget` (Number) Organization budget. Defaults to the system default when omitted during creation. Removing this attribute after setting it keeps the current API budget.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_org.example 123
```
